description: Collective Adaptive Systems resilience (de-probabilised, after Glazier-Camara-Schmerl-Garlan). A collective of self-adaptive managers (one cooperative coalition) defends against an attacker (adversary) that breaches members with bounded resources; a detecting member notifies others, which adapt and become invulnerable. Can the collective preemptively protect at least one member? Expected TRUE -- notification-based adaptation provides resilience. The quantitative survival fraction (topology-dependent: line ~0% survive, full ~61%) is abstracted; the paper's rPATL query is <<ATT>>R{compromised}max=?[F stop]. The collective size N and attacker resources are arbitrary.
